notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Hello Shovelers,

This patch adds Steam achievements and leaderboards for PC users (sorry Mac users, it crashes the Mac version). Leaderboards can be viewed through the Steam community page for Critical Mess. 

Each of the items have been given unique weights so that they react more realistically to physics forces. So heavy looking objects act heavy, light looking objects act light. This should mitigate the issue of objects flying across the room.

I also added a subtle screen shake to go along with the thrust of the shovel and for landing after a jump for a little added visual feedback to player input. 

Happy shoveling!

- Dan, DK VIP Lounge
